title: Suspension, Retention and Reactivation Figures for the VPS and Dedicated Servers Range
content:
Collections and the abuse desk work from four figures per tier in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range: the grace an unpaid server keeps running after its term end, the time a suspended server is kept before its disks are wiped, the fee to reactivate a server suspended for non-payment, and the time a customer has to answer an abuse report.

| Tier | Grace period: calendar days after the term end an unpaid server keeps running | Retention period: calendar days a suspended server is kept before its disks are wiped | Reactivation fee for a server suspended for non-payment (USD) | Abuse response time: elapsed hours to answer an abuse report before suspension |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 3 | 7 | 10.00 | 24 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 3 | 7 | 10.00 | 24 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 3 | 7 | 10.00 | 24 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 3 | 7 | 10.00 | 24 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 3 | 14 | 49.00 | 24 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 3 | 14 | 49.00 | 24 |

## Units

- The grace and the retention figures are counted in calendar days.
- The abuse response figure is counted in elapsed hours from the moment the report is forwarded to the customer.

## Comparing the tiers

The grace period and the abuse response time are the same on every tier. A dedicated machine is kept 14 days after suspension against 7 for a VPS, and its reactivation fee is 49.00 against 10.00.
